en.headline: Police arrest 22-year-old over fake flag-day scam for animal charity
en.dek: A man was detained after 14 people were hired via WhatsApp to collect donations while impersonating volunteers of the Hong Kong Saving Cat and Dog Association on its approved flag day.
body: Police have arrested a 22-year-old local man surnamed Lau on suspicion of obtaining property by deception after he was linked to a scam that used fake flag bags during an official flag day for an animal welfare group.

The Hong Kong Saving Cat and Dog Association held its Social Welfare Department-approved flag day across Kowloon on Saturday, deploying about 800 registered volunteers from 7am to noon. Staff reported that people carrying forged donation bags of a different shade of blue mixed with genuine volunteers near Langham Place in Mong Kok to solicit donations.

Officers found 14 individuals holding the fake bags. They told police they had answered a WhatsApp job advertisement offering HK$70 an hour to sell flags from 6.30am to 12.30pm, and that the organiser failed to collect the bags as arranged. The 14 were taken to Mong Kok Police Station for inquiries and are understood not to have known the bags were counterfeit.

Police said the arrested man is being held for further investigation by the Mong Kok District Crime Squad. The association urged the public to check that only one approved charity is collecting on any given flag day and to be wary of bags that do not match the official design.

zh.headline: 警拘22歲男子涉假冒貓狗協會賣旗詐騙
zh.dek: 香港拯救貓狗協會合法賣旗日，有人在旺角用假旗袋混入真義工隊募捐，警方截獲14名受僱臨時工後，今日拘捕一名本地男子。
body: 警方以涉嫌以欺騙手段取得財產罪拘捕一名22歲姓劉本地男子，懷疑他與昨日在旺角假冒義工賣旗的案件有關，案件交由旺角警區刑事部調查。
香港拯救貓狗協會昨日獲社會福利署批准在九龍區進行賣旗日，約800名義工由早上7時至中午12時在街頭籌款。協會職員發現有人在旺角朗豪坊一帶手持顏色較淺的偽造旗袋，混入真義工隊伍公然募捐，於是報警。
警員到場後截獲14名持有假旗袋的人士。他們表示在WhatsApp群組應徵時薪70元的臨時工，負責早上6時半至中午12時半在附近賣旗，約定完成後在奶路臣街收回旗袋，但對方最終失去聯絡。該14人稱不知旗袋是假的，已被帶往旺角警署協助調查。
協會提醒市民，同一天只會有一個獲批慈善機構賣旗，並籲留意旗袋顏色及設計是否與官方一致，以免善心被利用。
